scenes.setting: standing on a city sidewalk as a bright orange sports car drives past behind him, he points a thumb back at it with a skeptical face
scenes.line: Pasa un carrazo... ¿y qué decimos? 'Mmm, seguro es corrupto.'

scenes.setting: sitting at a modern warm kitchen table, leaning in close to the camera, lowering his voice like sharing a secret
scenes.line: Dicen que los latinos morimos más de envidia que de cáncer. Y la envidia... es mente pobre.

scenes.setting: close-up in the kitchen, shrugging with open bony palms, tilting his skull side to side comparing two options
scenes.line: El rico aplaude al que gana. El pobre lo critica. ¿Tú cuál eres?

scenes.setting: back at the kitchen table, pointing directly at the camera with a confident grin
scenes.line: Cambia tu mente y cambia tu bolsillo. Cursos gratis en biialab punto org. ¡Nos vemos!
